baseline: PriceUSD EOD UTC d-1, as in previous P3
events: same five registered parent episodes; Binance excluded where source does not cover it
recovery: existing frozen descriptive definition: 7 closes >= baseline, confirmed only on seventh close; compute subsequent 30-day outcomes from confirmation close
controls: reuse exact previous daily_control_candidates.csv; no new matching, no outcome selection; candidate references not news-screened controls
no_inference: price recovery is not liquidity normalization; does not validate H2 or establish causality, PIT, OOS, or a trading filter
